{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for non-numeric characters
print("\nAny non-numeric characters in revenue (excluding commas and periods)?")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', na=False).any())

# Look at the unique values to see if there are any anomalies
print("\nUnique revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())"}
